title: Compact Hydrogen Sulfide Emission Indicates Sulfur-bearing Ice Sublimation in the Inner Disk of HD 163296
question: Where do H2S, SO and SO2 emit in the HD 163296 disk, and do they trace sulfur-bearing ice sublimation in the inner disk?

evidence.quote: along with the high-resolution 0.88 mm dust continuum image taken from (cite: Guidi2022)

what.value: Disk geometry P.A.=133.3 deg, i=46.7 deg

evidence.quote: radial intensity profiles of the C$^{34}$S $J=6$–5 line (taken from (cite: Law2025))

what.value: Stellar mass 2.0 Msun and systemic velocity 5.76 km/s
Comet 67P and molecular cloud NIR38 abundances relative to water

evidence.quote: compare them with those in the molecular cloud NIR38 (cite: McClure2023) and comet 67P/C-G (cite: Calmonte2016)

recipe.method: Align execution blocks, self-calibrate continuum, apply to full data, subtract continuum, tclean
Integrate ±20 km/s about vsys; extract spectra from two-beam elliptical aperture
Matched filter with Keplerian disk (Rout 10 au) and SO2 stacking
Thin Keplerian disk, LTE, thermal broadening; free R, T, N per species plus common vsys (9 params)
assumptions: H2S ortho-to-para ratio 3; LTE; SO2 radius same as SO; M*=2.0 Msun; i=46.7 deg

recipe.goal: Column density ratios and water-relative abundances
recipe.method: Ratios from posterior samples with T>300 K; reanalyze archival water data for 3 sigma upper limits and compute abundances relative to water
key_parameters: line width 40 km/s; point source; H2O/H2(18)O=557; HDO/H2O=2e-3; H2O abundance 1e-4

answer_key.quantity: Water 3σ flux upper limits (H2O, H2-18O, HDO)

evidence.quote: to be 69, 96, and 48  mJy km s$^{-1}$ for H$_2$O, H$_2$$^{18}$O, and HDO lines
we derived a disk-averaged CH$_2$CN column density of $\approx1.1\times10^{13}$ cm$^{-2}$

not_stated_but_needed: Mean of the two SO2 line partition functions/molecular weights used
Water line frequencies and ARI-L product specifics for 2015.1.01259.S reanalysis
How the 1.2 km/s model was binned/convolved to channel resolution
score_reason: Public data and clear fitting recipe with priors, but several imaging and self-cal details unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, nearly complete recipe, numeric results (R, T, N limits).
